data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Okta OIDC authentication and token management
data.what_it_does: Enables secure user login, token management, and identity integration using OpenID Connect with Okta services. It provides methods for initialization, standard login, social login, access token retrieval, user profile fetching, and logout.
use_when: You need to authenticate users via Okta in your Flutter application
You require OIDC token management and social login options supported by Okta
avoid_when: You are using backend identity providers other than Okta
You do not want to manage native platform configuration for browser redirects
strengths: Simplifies Okta integration with ready-to-use methods for login, logout, and token handling
Supports social login options like LinkedIn, Google, and Apple sign-in via Okta
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced error handling and edge cases
Requires manual native platform setup for Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minSdkVersion 21 or above and adding appAuthRedirectScheme in Android build.gradle, setting minimum iOS deployment target to 13.0 in Podfile, and adding an assets/okta_config.json configuration file.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you are using Firebase as your backend authentication provider instead of Okta.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you only need Google Sign-In rather than full Okta OIDC integration.
